name: mailbox-standoff-grate
description: Raised drainage grate for a leaky mailbox interior. Floats mail ~15 mm above the pooled water on legs that reach the true floor inboard of the caulked corners. Prints as four interlocking dovetail-jigsaw quadrants (2x2) so each piece passes the smaller door and fits the 256 mm bed. Continuous 45-degree cross-hatch drainage mesh (~46% open) with one mostly-solid two-color letter per quadrant (M/H/H/K), each with small drain holes. Modeled in Fusion (dovetail tiles) + container-side shapely/trimesh (mesh field, letters, two-color split).

tolerances.note: 0.2 mm/side assembly clearance on the central jigsaw interlock (clearance fit so the four quadrants slot together by hand). Wall clearance to mailbox interior is 5 mm/side — generous, gravity-located, not a fit surface.

watertight_note: Open grate by design — drainage is the point. Each individual quadrant should be a clean manifold solid; the assembly is four separate bodies that interlock.
strain_note: Light load (letters/small parcels). No load case. Stiffness handled by rib depth + leg count, verified visually at review.
material_note: PLA for v1. A metal mailbox in summer sun can exceed PLA's ~60 C softening point; reprint in PETG or ASA if v1 sags. Geometry kept material-agnostic.

interior.front_lip_note: Lip is ~1 in deep into the cavity from the front wall, underside ~1/4 in off the floor. Deck floats above it; front legs sit behind it.
interior.door_opening_note: About 1 in smaller all around than the interior; large door. No exact number from user; 2x2 split makes it non-blocking.

params.float_height_note: Deck underside to floor. Within user's 1/2-3/4 in band; clears caulk fillets, thin water film, and the front lip.
params.letter_style: mostly-solid two-color glyph (Arial Black) with small drain holes

letters.note: Plan view, 'top'/'back' = far from door. One mostly-solid two-color letter per quadrant, set in the cross-hatch mesh.

params.center_junction: reinforce the 4-way meeting point (staggered seam or keyed central boss) so the middle does not splay/hinge

legs.setback_reason: land on flat floor behind the 1-in front lip; clear the corner caulk fillets

requiresId_note: User is speccing the look directly. The grate has a visible 'face' (vortex + letters) — escalate to id-designer if letters read muddy on the first render.
modeling_note: modeler-fusion subagent runs BLIND and fabricates 'validated live' claims — use it as a script-author only; run every revision live from the main session (see feedback_fusion_subagent_blind_validation).

heroRender.note: Top-down shows the vortex pattern + M/H/H/K letters — the distinctive face of the part.

testPrintCandidates.reason: 0.2 mm/side puzzle clearance — print a short mating pair from two adjacent quadrants to confirm the interlock slots together snugly before committing to all four full pieces.

testPrintCandidates.feature: Quadrant corner with legs + vortex ribs
testPrintCandidates.reason: Verify leg height/stability, rib width, and that the letter reads in the swirl on a single printed corner before full pieces.
